title: Payout Limits and Instant Payout Fees — Pocketwire Business Profile
content:
The payout figures of the Pocketwire Business Profile are set per tier. The daily payout limit caps the sum of payouts initiated on one calendar day, Eastern Time. Column headings abbreviate the six tiers of the Pocketwire Business Profile: Pocketwire Business Starter, Pocketwire Business Essentials, Pocketwire Business Growth, Pocketwire Business Pro, Pocketwire Business Premier and Pocketwire Business Enterprise.

## Instant payout fee to a debit card

| | Starter | Essentials | Growth | Pro | Premier | Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Fee, percent of the payout | 1.75% | 1.75% | 1.50% | 1.50% | 1.25% | 1.00% |
| Minimum fee | USD 0.25 | USD 0.25 | USD 0.25 | USD 0.25 | USD 0.25 | USD 0.25 |
| Maximum fee | USD 25.00 | USD 25.00 | USD 25.00 | USD 20.00 | USD 15.00 | USD 10.00 |

## Limits and timing

| | Starter | Essentials | Growth | Pro | Premier | Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Daily payout limit | USD 5000.00 | USD 10000.00 | USD 25000.00 | USD 50000.00 | USD 100000.00 | USD 250000.00 |
| Maximum amount of one instant payout | USD 2500.00 | USD 5000.00 | USD 10000.00 | USD 25000.00 | USD 50000.00 | USD 100000.00 |
| Smallest payout amount | USD 5.00 | USD 5.00 | USD 1.00 | USD 1.00 | USD 1.00 | USD 1.00 |
| Latest arrival of a standard bank payout (business days) | 3 | 3 | 2 | 2 | 1 | 1 |
| Daily automatic standard bank payout can be switched on | no | no | yes | yes | yes | yes |

## Distinctions

- The minimum and maximum fee bound the instant payout fee; they are not limits on the payout amount.
- The daily payout limit and the maximum of one instant payout are separate figures. On Pocketwire Business Starter they are USD 5000.00 and USD 2500.00.
- Illustration (hypothetical payout): an instant payout of USD 400.00 on Pocketwire Business Growth works out at 1.50%, USD 6.00, which lies between USD 0.25 and USD 25.00.
